executive_summary: Advanced Air Mobility reached a commercial milestone as Joby Aviation launched its first NYC eVTOL service, while Elroy Air completed autonomous flights under the DOT’s pilot program. In autonomous vehicles, the NHTSA escalated its investigation into Tesla’s Cybercab, threatening legal action over the lack of manual controls. Geopolitical tensions intensified with NATO intercepting hostile drones over Lithuania and the U.S. House passing a measure to end ongoing conflicts, amid reports of damage to U.S. bases from Iranian attacks.
what_to_watch: Joby Aviation has commenced its first commercial eVTOL flights in New York City, operating a 7-minute route between JFK Airport and Manhattan, marking a significant milestone in the integration of Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) into urban transportation networks.

The U.S. House of Representatives has passed a measure requiring President Trump to end the ongoing conflict, while new imagery reveals widespread damage to U.S. military positions from Iranian missile and drone attacks, highlighting escalating tensions and domestic political pressure regarding foreign policy.

NATO fighter jets have shot down a drone originating from Belarus over Lithuania, and an Italian fighter jet intercepted a suspected Russian drone for NATO, indicating heightened aerial security threats and active counter-drone operations within European airspace.

Trump Administration Wins.eo_section_summary: accelerating safe U.S. eVTOL deployment through eIPP
Trump Administration Wins.win_explanation: Under the Trump Administration, DOT and FAA’s eIPP completed its first operational flight, implementing EO 14307’s direction to advance electric vertical-takeoff-and-landing operations. The milestone supports U.S. aviation commercialization, high-skilled jobs, and new medical, cargo, and passenger services.

Top Developments.title: NATO Fighter Jets Shot Down Drone From Belarus Over Lithuania Near Pratkūnai: 18 outlets compared
Top Developments.summary: NATO fighter jets intercepted and shot down a drone from Belarus over Lithuania, with Lithuanian authorities confirming it carried explosives. An Italian fighter jet also downed a suspected Russian drone for NATO. In the Middle East, the U.S. has raised its travel advisory for Saudi Arabia to Level 3 due to drone threats reaching Mecca, where Saudi defenses intercepted a drone. Ukraine continues to use drones to strike Russian infrastructure, including Arctic gas facilities, and has tested new anti-drone weapons. The EU is considering tougher responses to Russian hybrid attacks, while the U.S. DoD Counter-Drone Task Force projects a $30 billion annual market by 2030. India’s CISF has partnered with IIT Kanpur to enhance anti-drone capabilities.

Top Developments.title: Joby Flies JFK to Manhattan in 7 Minutes: First NYC eVTOL Flights (2026)
Top Developments.summary: Joby Aviation has launched its first commercial eVTOL flights in New York City, connecting JFK Airport to Manhattan in just seven minutes. This development coincides with regulatory advancements, including a House panel advancing AAM certification legislation and Surf Air Mobility participating in the FAA’s Project Nexus event. Meanwhile, infrastructure challenges persist, with São Paulo racing to wire vertiports and battery weight remaining a barrier to broader commercialization. Financially, Beta Bionics has secured FDA clearance for its insulin patch pump and plans a public offering, while Apple’s stock fell after Siri AI launched with a beta label. Archer Aviation is also under scrutiny for potential undervaluation following its city-to-city flight tours.

Top Developments.title: Latest war news. US House of Representatives passes a measure requiring Trump to end the conflict
Top Developments.summary: The U.S. House of Representatives has passed a measure requiring President Trump to end the ongoing conflict, amid reports of major damage to U.S. bases from Iranian missile and drone attacks. Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met with Germany’s defense minister to discuss NATO 3.0 and defense industrial cooperation. Domestically, the Kennedy Center board voted to close due to financial woes and a branding dispute with Trump. Internationally, Trump reportedly approved Chinese car plants, while Tesla faces regulatory questions on Cybercab certification. The UK’s climate advisers warned that Heathrow expansion requires full airline emissions action.

Top Developments.title: Delhi-Siliguri bullet train: 20-hour Delhi journey may shrink to 6 hours 45 mins; details here
Top Developments.summary: India is expanding its high-speed rail network with new bullet train projects connecting Delhi to Siliguri and Patna, significantly reducing travel times. The country has also launched its first hydrogen-powered train, advancing green mobility. In the U.S., reports highlight wasteful travel expenses by California High-Speed Rail consultants, while the NTSB cited SEPTA’s maintenance program in a trolley accident. NASA’s X-59 test pilot conducted ground tests, and Waymo partnered to launch Tokyo’s first autonomous robotaxi service by 2027. EU freight rail saw a decline, while Poland attracted bidders for a high-speed rail power system. Tesla’s Cybercab faces certification questions, and Trump reportedly approved Chinese car plants.
